ch05.anchor: the Military Affairs Commission of the National Government
ch05.note: The Military Affairs Commission (军事委员会), the supreme organ of the Nationalist armed forces, chaired by Chiang Kai-shek. Through the war years it was in practice the command center of the whole Nationalist state, standing above the civil government; Dai Li's secret service was lodged within it. It was wound up in 1946, its functions passing to the new Ministry of National Defense (named later in this book).
